theme_and_archetype.description: Enterprise-grade, highly functional, and authoritative. Clean, sober, and minimal aesthetic tailored to telecommunications and field operations.

typography.rules: No Inter. Use typography scales that prioritize data scannability.

monospace.usage: Used for IP addresses, MAC addresses, ticket IDs, and log timestamps.

layout_architecture.global: Left Sidebar App Shell pattern (replaces top-tabs). Fixed sidebar (width: 260px) on desktop, hamburger off-canvas on mobile.
layout_architecture.topbar: Sticky top bar (h-14) with global search, breadcrumbs, server clock, notifications bell, and user profile.
layout_architecture.page_content: Max-width wrapper within the remaining viewport. Uses 'F-pattern' layout. Generous padding (p-6 or p-8).
layout_architecture.map_panels: Split view: 70% width for React-Leaflet map, 30% width for data/filter side panel.

card.header: Border-bottom on header to separate from content. p-5.
card.content: p-5 for text, p-0 for tables to ensure edge-to-edge flush design.

button.primary: bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 rounded-md font-medium px-4 py-2 transition-colors

kanban_lousa.layout: Horizontal scroll container. Columns represent technicians (or time slots, depending on backend mapping).
kanban_lousa.column_header: Sticky top, shows technician avatar, name, and total tickets.
kanban_lousa.ticket_card: Minimalist bubble card. Left border color indicates priority. Contains: Ticket ID (mono), Customer Name (truncate), Location chip, SLA Timer (red/amber/green pill).
kanban_lousa.interactions: Drag-and-drop affordance visible on hover (grip icon). Quick actions dropdown (⋮) on right.

banners.impersonation: Solid warning surface (bg-amber-100 border-amber-300 text-amber-900) instead of violet gradients. Fixed top, minimal padding.
banners.super_admin: Outlined chip (border-slate-800 text-slate-800) instead of gradient fills.

icons_and_assets.rules: No emojis. Replace all current emojis with sleek, uniform 1.5px stroke weight Lucide icons.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Fast, functional animations. 150ms ease-in-out for hovers.
motion_and_interactions.modals: Fade-in + subtle slide-up (translate-y-2) using Framer Motion.
motion_and_interactions.kanban: Layout animations for drag-and-drop state changes.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements MUST have role-based data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='lousa-ticket-drag-handle', data-testid='sidebar-nav-link-estoque').

phase_1.name: Design Tokens & App Shell refactor
actions: Update tailwind.config.js with new color palette (Slate/Teal), typography (Satoshi/Manrope), and remove any legacy purple/violet gradients.
Refactor App.js: Remove top tabs and replace with a Left Sidebar navigation.
Implement persistent Top Bar with breadcrumbs and server clock.
Remove all inline styles in App.js.

phase_2.name: Lousa (Kanban) Redesign
actions: Refactor LousaAdminPanel to use a strict columnar layout (technicians as columns).
Redesign ticket bubble cards removing gradients, using priority left-borders and SLA status pills.
Implement Shadcn/UI primitives (Dialog, Select, Input, DropdownMenu) across all Lousa Modals.
Ensure drag-and-drop logic is preserved and visually clear.

phase_3.name: Core Panels & Map Views
actions: Refactor AI Center and Praças map panels to a 70/30 split layout (Map/Sidebar).
Update Estoque and Cadastro to use Shadcn Table with sticky headers and robust filtering.
Redesign metrics/stat cards using the new Card component standard.

phase_4.name: Settings, Mobile & Landing
actions: Refactor Settings to use a left-vertical tab layout (Section-based).
Redesign CollaboratorApp for mobile: large functional CTAs, high-contrast offline indicators.
Revamp LandingPage and LoginPage to match the 'Enterprise SaaS 2026' aesthetic using the new typography and color tokens.
Remove any final lingering emojis and custom UI components from ui.js.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement changes using strictly raw HTML/Tailwind for layouts and customized Shadcn/UI for interactive components. Follow the 4-phase plan meticulously. DO NOT use the .tsx extension for any new or modified files; the project uses .js. ALWAYS preserve data-testid attributes for testing.
